images.caption: Ronald Simmons, Walter B. Simmons Sr., Ronald Simmons Jr. and  Solomon Myers III, maintain a unified pose in front of the Martin Luther King Jr. Memorial in Washington, D.C., June 19, 2014.  The men are part of the Alpha Phi Alpha, the first African American fraternity group in America, which petitioned for the monument to be erected.  (U.S. Air Force photo/Senior Airman Jette Carr)

images.caption: Bernard Cissa plays music June 19, 2014, at the Martin Luther King Jr. Memorial in Washington, D.C.  The memorial was erected in 2011 in tribute of King’s contributions toward civil rights.  Cissa is a musician from Senegal, who chose to record music in front of King’s statue to connect with a man he considers a hero.  (U.S. Air Force photo/Senior Airman Jette Carr)
images.alt: Bernard Cissa plays music June 19, 2014, at the Martin Luther King Jr. Memorial in Washington, D.C.
